parameters.content:
## AI support agent: web chat + Telegram + WhatsApp, one brain
**Live demo:** https://n8n.rixgpt.com/webhook/support

1. Three doors: the web chat (POST /support/message), the Telegram Trigger and the WhatsApp Trigger (Cloud API test number). Each is normalised to channel / chat id / name / text.
2. **Prepare message** loads the conversation memory (static data, 7 days), applies the limits, handles /start and the owner /claim, detects order numbers and attaches the matching sample orders, and builds one **Gemini** request (knowledge base + orders + last 8 turns).
3. Gemini returns JSON: reply, intent, confidence, sentiment, handoff. **Compose reply** creates a ticket on the first hand-off, emails the owner (Gmail API) and alerts the owner's Telegram chat.
4. The reply goes back through the same door (Respond / Telegram / WhatsApp) and every turn is appended to **Google Sheets** (Support chats tab). Private owner view with transcripts and tickets.

Limits: 30 msgs per web session, 40 per Telegram/WhatsApp chat, 300 a day. Harborline Goods, the orders and the policies are fictional.
Built by Aqib ur Rehman.
